Name: Seeds N' Saplings - Ridgeside Village
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LLgZP0j.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Seeds N' Saplings add-on for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], can be used without [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29387]Seeds N' Saplings[/url], but will look best with the matching seedbags and saplings

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Aj354v4.png[/img]﻿[/center][center][/center][u][b]Seasonal Saplings[/b][/u]
This option colour codes saplings to their harvest/fruiting season. Green for spring, pink for summer, brown for autumn and blue for winter, just like the craftable wild seed bags. This is especially handy in case you happen to be forgetful like me and have many modded crops. There are two different Seasonal Options.

[u][b]Non Seasonal Saplings[/b][/u]
With this option, saplingsstay the same colour all year around, and has six different colour options to choose from.

[u][b]Seasonal Sapling Leaves[/b][/u]
The leaves on saplings will change with the seasons depending on the fully grown tree or bush. [i]Disabled by default.[/i]

[u][b]Different Sapling Designs[/b][/u]
You can pick between the usual, vanilla game's sack or a garden pot for tree saplings.

[u][b]Highly Configurable[/b][/u]
This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/PoStKKx.png[/img]﻿[/center][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿ (Along with its dependancies).
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
[*]Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
[*]When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking
[/list]
You're all done and ready to play

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/9oxH5zG.png[/img][/center][list]
